name: Marcus Vale

greeting.stranger: I need to speak with you. Privately. It's urgent.
greeting.acquaintance: You've proven trustworthy. I have more information.
greeting.friend: My friend, you're the only one I can trust with this.
greeting.confidant: I'm putting my career on the line here. But it's the right thing to do.

questRelated.nr_coruscant_01_whispers: I work for Senator Vorin. He's... he's corrupt. I've seen things—bribes, kickbacks, deals with the Corporate Sector. I can't prove it alone, but I know it's true. The New Republic is supposed to be better than the Empire, but people like Vorin are making it just as bad. I need someone to investigate, someone who can't be bought or intimidated. Will you help me expose him?

general: I came to Coruscant to make a difference. Now I'm not sure I can.
The Senate is supposed to represent the people. But some senators only represent themselves.
I've seen how power corrupts. It's not pretty.
The New Republic needs to be better. We can't let corruption take root.
I'm risking everything by coming forward. But it's the right thing to do.

appearance.distinguishingFeatures: Senate aide uniform, constantly checking surroundings, nervous demeanor, datapad

biography: Marcus Vale is a young, idealistic aide who works for Senator Vorin. He came to Coruscant full of hope, wanting to serve the New Republic. But working for Vorin has shown him the dark side of politics—corruption, bribery, and abuse of power. He's torn between loyalty to his job and his conscience. He's finally decided to act, but he needs help. He represents the struggle between idealism and reality in the New Republic.
